about_item: Secure Fit for High-Intensity Sports & Specific Ergonomics: Engineered for continuous movement, these earbuds wireless bluetooth feature flexible silicone earhooks that adapt to your specific ear contour. The pressure-distributing design explicitly solves wear-fatigue for users with smaller ear canals and those who wear glasses. Whether navigating rugged cycling trails or running marathons, the running earbuds remain locked in place without requiring mid-workout adjustments.

Immersive Bass & Environmental Noise Cancelling (ENC) Calls: Powered by 13mm dynamic drivers, the energetic soundstage delivers punchy bass to fuel your training momentum. Simultaneously, the integrated ENC Mics system addresses noisy environments by instantly isolating your vocal frequencies. The noise cancelling earbuds actively filter out disruptive background sounds like loud gym music or urban traffic, ensuring crystal-clear phone calls and virtual meetings without pausing your routine.

48 Hrs Continuous Ecosystem with Dual LED Display: The Bluetooth earbuds are designed to eliminate battery anxiety during long-distance activities. A single 1.5 hrs USB-C fast charge delivers up to 8 hrs of uninterrupted playback. The compact charging case extends this ecosystem to a total of 48 hrs. The high-contrast dual LED digital display provides immediate, visual confirmation of the exact battery percentage for both the case and individual earbuds, keeping you prepared.

Unbreakable Bluetooth 5.3 & Auto-Reconnection: Experience flawless synchronization from the gym floor to the office desk. Upgraded Bluetooth 5.3 ensures an ultra-stable, low-latency connection, eliminating frustrating audio dropouts even in signal-dense environments crowded with electronics. The smart Hall sensor immediately pairs these wireless headphones to your phone, tablets, or laptop the moment you open the case. Switch seamlessly between devices to keep your playlists uninterrupted.

Intuitive Smart Touch Control at Your Fingertips: The over the ear earbuds feature high-sensitivity touch panels for direct control of music, volume, calls, track switching, and voice assistants. Effortlessly manage audio in libraries, home relaxation, or cafés without touching your phone. These wireless ear buds are compatible with iOS, Android, and most Bluetooth devices, enabling seamless switching across smartphones, tablets, and laptops for versatile multitasking.

Defined Protection for Active Daily Environments: The Csasan workout earbuds carry an IPX7 protection rating engineered to withstand sweat, rain exposure, and elevated humidity commonly encountered during active daily use. The protective structure of bluetooth earphones is built to maintain durability and stable performance under frequent movement and changing conditions. This level of protection supports everyday reliability, but is not intended for swimming or prolonged underwater use.

summary.text: Customers find these wireless earbuds comfortable, secure, and easy to pair with phones and computers. The sound quality is good, with one customer noting the call clarity, and they appreciate the fit, with one mentioning they work well under a riding helmet. The battery life and reliability receive mixed feedback - while some say the charge lasts long, others report it doesn't stay charged for long, and while the earbuds work well initially, some mention they stop working after 15 minutes. Customers consider them good value for money, with one noting they're better than Apple AirPods.
